Flow.description:
Products in this calculation: Enrollment Fee - FWSFS1600 ACH PNC Gateway for SFS - FWPAY2110 CC - First Data - FWPAY1700 CC - Flywire MoR - FWPAY1800
Updated to use OpportunityLineItem instead of SBQQ_QuoteLine__c. Updated 08/27/2024 to loop through the quote lines to check if ARR should include collection management. Including Net price calculations. Updated 09/06/2024 to account for different ARR components. Use autocalculated Actual 12 Months Tuition CC Vol if not filled by rep. Updated 09/12/2024 calculate each portion of arr depending on the quote lines added to the quote. BOPI-511 Updated to calculate ARR when Quote Line Type not 'Cancellation' or 'Renewal'. Updated 09/25/2024 Calculate ARR components depending on Dynamic Billing or Collection Management product. Updated 11/22/2024 to add Third Party invoicing calculation. BOPI-589 Updated 11/26/2024 to replace deprecated Net Price field. BOPI-605, updated to move TPI from this automation to a new separate automation for that product. BOPI-603 updated to set ARR to 0 for cancelled lines. BOPI-620 updated to set the ARR for cancelled lines to the original amount as a negative value. SALDEV-1185, Updated formulas for Payment Plans ARR calculations, added new criteria for Calculate ARR step.
SALDEV - 1413: Quote Line field Quoted_Usage_Amt__c, Quoted_Usage_Percent__c replaced with Average_Quoted_Usage_Amount__c, Average_Quoted_Usage_Percent__c
